## About

Regional economist, spatial data scientist and researcher with ~15 years’ experience building data products and reproducible tools for complex research and policy questions. I turn UK, regional and local data into rapid, decision-ready evidence for research organisations, combined authorities, local government and others. I'm always trying to find new ways to understand and show what the data means, build the data-science, geospatial and data-engineering pipelines to interrogate it, and use my economics/politics to put it in context. I can then explain the results clearly to policymakers. Areas include regional economics, economic geography, spatial analysis, econometrics and data visualisation. Increasingly working with Generative AI and LLMs, including agentic coding with tools such as Claude Code to rapidly prototype and build complete analytical and research tools. PhD economic geography; experienced teacher and trainer. Committed to open-source, reproducible tools, knowledge transfer and capacity building.
